loopIdea: The reel closes on the same dashboard temperature needle beat 1 opened on, settled back at mid-scale, so a replay begins with that same needle creeping upward again.
mechanicTruth: Airflow through the radiator at road speed does the cooling on its own, so a car that heats up only at a standstill and cools back down once it is moving points at the electric fan circuit rather than the radiator; on a warmed-up engine that fan should be spinning while the car sits still.
